meta.title: Design Proposal — Cornerstone Christian Academy — Bryan, Texas
hero.sub: A Christ-centered K–12 academy in Bryan, Texas — where every child is known by name.
statement.text: Since 2002, Cornerstone has believed that educating a child takes a Biblical foundation and a true partnership with the family — so that every student will increase in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and man.
chapel.p: Songs, prayer and a word from Scripture, every morning. On Fridays, every class recites its memory verse together.
nums.top10s: Nationally on the Stanford Achievement Test
div.p: Core academics every morning. Bible, Spanish, art, music, computers and PE every afternoon. Teachers who know your child.
div.lowerP: Reading, wonder and Scripture memory. Full-day or part-day core options, with extended care from 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM.
div.middleP: Great books, applied mathematics and lab science — plus Spanish, American Sign Language, band and athletics. NJHS.
div.upperP: College-preparatory rigor, the National Honor Society and dual credit through Blinn College.
div.faithP: Daily Bible classes, chapel, the Bob & JoAnn Walker Day of Service and work days at Messiah’s Ranch.
ath.p: The Lady Cougars claimed a second straight Texas Christian Athletic League Class 2A title — 60 to 30 over Marshall Christian.
her.h: It started with forty believers and one question.
her.lead: In July 2001, Christians across Bryan–College Station gathered to imagine a school that would surround children with the love of God — and equip them to become whatever God intends.
her.openP: August 18 — eleven kindergarten and pre-K students.
her.readingP: By 2005, our kindergartners ranked among the nation’s best in total reading.
her.accP: The smallest school ever accredited by the Southern Association.
her.sciP: The first and only Science Academy in Brazos County.
her.gradsP: A grade added every year — until our first senior class walked.
her.champsP: The Lady Cougars win back-to-back TCAL Class 2A titles.
sent.p: Cornerstone graduates go on to Texas A&M, Harding University, Blinn College and beyond — prepared to go boldly into the world with purpose and love.
adm.lead: Admission is open year-round as space allows. Every family is welcome to a free three-day trial, so your child can experience Cornerstone before you decide.
adm.s1p: Call or email our office to start the conversation.
adm.s2p: Free days in the classroom — for your child and for you.
adm.s3p: Application, enrollment documents and immunization records.
adm.s4p: With the principal or a member of the Board.
adm.s5p: Registration secures your child’s seat. Welcome, Cougar.
pt.lead: Announcements, grades, private messages with teachers, and official school documents — requested in seconds and issued digitally.
pt.f1s: Every notice from school and class, in one feed.
pt.f2s: Direct, private conversations with every teacher.
pt.f4s: Enrollment letters, transcripts and more — download when ready.

nums.h:

div.h:

intl.h:
A home in Texas.

intl.p: Cornerstone is SEVP-certified and issues Form I-20 for F-1 students. Families from around the world trust us with their children — and those students are thriving at the top of their class.
intl.alt: International students laughing together on campus steps
pg.about.title: About — Cornerstone Christian Academy
about.sub: A Christ-centered, Biblically based K–12 school in Bryan, Texas — since 2002.
about.school.lead: Brazos Valley Cornerstone Christian Academy is a Christ-centered, Biblically based K–12 private school. We meet in the Cavitt Church of Christ building in Bryan, and we partner with families so that every student will grow in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and man.
about.school.c1p: Kindergarten through Grade 12, with extended care.
about.school.c4p: Bryan, Texas 77801 — in the Cavitt Church of Christ building.
about.acc.lead: Cornerstone is accredited by Cognia (AdvancED), formerly SACS — and was the smallest school ever accredited by SACS.
about.acc.c1p: Cognia / AdvancED, formerly the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools (SACS).
about.acc.c3p: National Honor Society and National Junior Honor Society.
about.pack.lead: PACK raises funds and organizes activities through the year that help our teachers and students reach their goals. Please send at least one family member to PACK meetings.
about.board.lead: An appointed Board of Directors sets the school’s policies and governs it under the corporation’s bylaws.
pg.academics.title: Academics — Cornerstone Christian Academy
acad.prog.h: A full day, shaped with purpose.
acad.prog.lead: Every day begins in chapel. Core subjects fill the morning; Bible, computers, Spanish, art, music and PE fill the afternoon. On Fridays, every class recites its memory verse together.
acad.prog.c1p: Focused time for the core academic subjects.
acad.prog.c2p: Bible · Computers · Spanish · Art · Music · PE
acad.div.p: Lower, Middle and Upper School — each with teachers who know your child by name.
acad.opt.h: A school day that fits your family.
acad.opt.lead: Choose a traditional full day, a part-day core program for Kindergarten through Grade 5, or homeschool enrichment — with extended care before and after school.
acad.dual.lead: Through dual credit with Blinn College, Upper School students can begin earning college credit while still at Cornerstone.
acad.dual.c1p: College courses taken alongside high school.
acad.dual.c2p: Recognizing scholarship, service, leadership and character.
acad.dual.c3p: Texas A&M, Harding University, Blinn College and beyond.
acad.h1:
Mornings for the core.
Afternoons for the whole child.
pg.admissions.title: Admissions — Cornerstone Christian Academy
admp.apply.lead: Admission is open year-round as space allows. Start with a call or an email — we would love to meet your family.
admp.prep.lead: The application, tuition, the handbook and supply lists are all on this page.
admp.prep.c1p: The application and the school’s enrollment documents.
admp.prep.c2p: Up-to-date immunizations, as required for enrollment.
admp.prep.c4p: A nonrefundable registration fee secures your child’s seat.
admp.tu.lead: Significant discounts for a second child and for early enrollment.
admp.tu.n1p: On the 7th of each month: August–May on the 10-month plan, August–July on the 12-month plan. Card payments cost extra.
admp.tu.n2p: 5% off when the full year is paid in advance, 4% for a semester. Deadline: August 1.
admp.tu.n3p: The registration fee is paid each year and is nonrefundable.
admp.tu.n4p: After-school care runs 3:30–5:30 PM at $7.50 per hour.
admp.hb.lead: The 2026–27 handbook covers the school day, attendance, grading, conduct, the dress code and more. Please read it together as a family.
admp.hb.c1p: 8:00 AM – 3:15 PM. Core classes for K–5 end at 1:45 PM, followed by enrichment.
admp.hb.c2p: Doors open at 7:30 AM. Cars line up on Willow Street, passenger side toward campus.
admp.hb.c3p: Brought from home and ready to eat; there is no microwave. Kindergartners also bring a daily snack.
admp.hb.c4p: Grades 1–5: A+ to F, with plus and minus. Grades 6–12: A 90–100, B 80–89, C 70–79, F below 70.
admp.sup.lead: Label starred items with your child’s name. Unlabeled items go into the shared class supply.
admp.sup.note: Each list also names shared supplies the office welcomes, such as copy paper, wipes and tissues. They are a blessing, not a requirement.
admp.uni.lead: School is a place of work, and how we dress matters. In the community, a uniform represents Cornerstone.
admp.uni.c1p: Polo shirts in white, gold or black with the school logo, tucked in.
admp.uni.c2p: Black or khaki dress pants, shorts, skirts or jumpers. No denim or cargo pockets; knee length.
admp.uni.c3p: Closed-toe shoes for outdoor play. No flip-flops, sandals or clogs.
admp.uni.c4p: Spirit day: neat jeans with an approved Cornerstone T-shirt.
admp.uni.c5p: The Cougar T-shirt, unless the teacher says otherwise.
admp.uni.c6p: Coats, sweaters or hoodies worn indoors must be Cornerstone-approved or carry the school logo.
admp.uni.more: Full dress code in the handbook (PDF)
pg.enrichment.title: Enrichment — Cornerstone Christian Academy
enr.sub: Athletics, languages, the arts and technology — part of every Cornerstone week.
enr.ath.note: Some sports are offered together with BVCHEA.
enr.aft.lead: Enrichment is built into every school day. Afternoons bring Bible, computers, Spanish, art, music and PE.
enr.lang.lead: Spanish is part of the afternoon program, and Middle School students can also choose American Sign Language as an elective.
pg.studentLife.title: Student Life — Cornerstone Christian Academy
sl.sub: Chapel every morning, character celebrated every week, and service that reaches beyond our walls.
sl.char.eyebrow: Cougar of the Week & The Bee Kind People
sl.char.lead: Two Cornerstone traditions recognize kindness and character in everyday school life.
sl.char.c1p: An award that celebrates a student each week.
sl.char.c2p: A project that encourages kindness across the school.
sl.trips.lead: Teachers and chaperone parents take students on educational field trips. Students wear the Cougar T-shirt.
sl.trips.c1p: Bring your license and proof of insurance to the office, and carry a permission note for every child you drive.
sl.trips.c2p: Two adults aged 21 or older ride in each car when possible; otherwise cars travel as a caravan.
sl.trips.c3p: Conduct on a trip is held to the same standard as in the classroom.
sl.svc.lead: Students put their faith into action through the Bob & JoAnn Walker Day of Service and work days at Messiah’s Ranch.
sl.svc.c1p: Each January, classes pause and students serve on and off campus.
sl.svc.c2p: Students roll up their sleeves to help.
sl.gal.lead: Moments from past school years, from the school’s own photo archive.
sl.fund.lead: Fundraisers pay for the extras: playground equipment, scholarships, curriculum, PE equipment and computers.
sl.fund.c1p: Our one big fundraiser of the year.
sl.fund.c2p: The parent association holds fundraisers for different causes through the year.
sl.fund.c3p: Students may sell to family and friends, never door to door.

pv.who.p1: Brazos Valley Cornerstone Christian Academy (“Cornerstone”, “the school”), 3200 Cavitt Avenue, Bryan, Texas 77801, runs this website and the Family Portal. Questions about privacy: office@bvcca.com or (979) 694-8200.
pv.site.p1: The public website uses no cookies, analytics or advertising trackers. Your browser keeps only your language choice, on your own device.
pv.site.p2: The admissions inquiry form sends nothing to us by itself: it opens your own email app, and you decide whether to send the message.
pv.data.p1: Account details for parents, guardians and staff: name, email address, role and preferred language.
pv.data.p2: Student records the school already keeps: name, grade, student ID, grades, attendance, document requests and issued documents.
pv.data.p3: Messages between families and school staff, and school announcements.
pv.use.p1: Only to run the school and to communicate with families: sharing grades and attendance, answering messages, issuing requested documents and sending notices. We do not sell personal information or use it for advertising.
pv.access.p1: Parents and guardians see only their own children’s records. Teachers see the students in their own classes. Office staff see what they need to run the school. These limits are enforced by the system itself (row-level security), not only by the screens you see.
pv.ferpa.p1: Where the U.S. Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA) applies, parents — and students once they turn 18 — may inspect education records, ask for corrections, and must give consent before records are shared outside the school, except where the law allows. Questions can be raised with the school office.
pv.kids.p1: Portal accounts are for parents, guardians and school staff. Students do not create accounts, and we do not knowingly collect personal information online directly from children under 13.
pv.providers.p1: The portal is hosted by Supabase (database, sign-in and file storage) and the website by GitHub Pages. They process information only to provide those services to the school.
pv.security.p1: Connections are encrypted (HTTPS). Issued documents are kept in private storage and downloaded through short-lived private links. Portal accounts are by invitation only.
pv.keep.p1: Records are kept as long as the school needs them and as the law requires. When a family leaves, portal access is closed; school records follow the school’s records-retention policy.
pv.choices.p1: You can change your name and language in the portal, ask the office to correct information, or ask to close your account by writing to office@bvcca.com.
pv.changes.p1: We will post changes on this page with a new date and tell portal users about important changes.
pg.privacy.title: Privacy Policy — Cornerstone Christian Academy
privacy.sub: How Cornerstone handles information on this website and in the Family Portal.
tm.use.p1: By using this website or the Family Portal you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use them.
tm.accounts.p1: The school office creates accounts by invitation. Keep your password private and do not share your account. Tell the office right away if you think someone else has used it.
tm.conduct.p1: Use the portal for school matters only. Do not post anything unkind, unlawful or unrelated to school, try to reach other families’ information, or interfere with the service.
tm.content.p1: Text, photos, logos and documents on this site belong to the school or are used with permission. An issued document is official only as stated on the document itself.
tm.accuracy.p1: We work to keep information current, but schedules, fees and policies can change. The school office has the final word.
tm.availability.p1: We aim to keep the portal available but cannot promise that it will always be uninterrupted or free of errors.
tm.privacy.p1: Our Privacy Policy explains how we handle information.
tm.law.p1: These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Texas.
tm.contact.p1: Brazos Valley Cornerstone Christian Academy · 3200 Cavitt Avenue, Bryan, Texas 77801 · office@bvcca.com · (979) 694-8200
